items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that keeps dry, flaky-looking skin from feeling stripped.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to support comfort and moisture, which scored low in your scan.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides for daily protection, blending well on deeper skin tones.

response.routine_note: I left out the glycolic toner and vitamin C serum because exfoliating acids and strong actives are too harsh for skin while you are on isotretinoin, so please ask your prescriber or dermatologist about the flaking and before adding any actives. Use the cleanser morning and night, follow with the cream, and finish with SPF every morning.
